metadata.description: An explicit edge to browser:build-base, NOT `^build`. This entry point cannot compile before the parent's dist exists, so the edge is real -- but it has to be spelled out, because `^build` here would resolve to browser:build, which depends on this very target: a hard cycle. That XOR is the whole design constraint -- either the children get `^build` or the parent aggregates them, never both. Aggregating is the side that keeps one writer per dist directory. This entry point also imports @dereekb/util/oidc and @dereekb/util/fetch, subpaths the parent does NOT depend on. Cross-family deps are spelled as the other family's ROOT `build` (not `build-base`, and not that family's child project): a sibling family's child has no `build` of its own and writes into its parent's dist, so `util:build` -- which runs the ESM finalize -- is the only thing that produces a finalized copy for TypeScript to resolve `exports` against.
